entities.name: Shaheed Bhagat Singh College
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Shaheed Bhagat Singh College (SBSC), named after Bhagat Singh, was established as a co-educational institute in 1967 as one of the constituent colleges of the University of Delhi. It acquired postgraduate status in a record time of seven years.
